transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. We've got the 'Second Harbor' table reading coming up on May 14, and we need to finalize our principal casting for Dr. Vale, Jules, and Mara. We have Omar, Priya, Lila, and Sora on the shortlist. Before I issue any final casting call and protocol decisions, I need the relevant production leads to complete their routine pre-read review here in the room. Once that's done, I'll make the binding casting and protocol decisions. Who's ready to kick things off?

transcript.text: Before we proceed, I need to flag something important. I confirmed with Omar's agent this morning that Omar is available for the role of Dr. Vale only on May 14, and he cannot accept the role unless that date is fixed in the call sheet.
